about: Attacks of the bosses. min_m/max_m: distance to the hunter at which the attack is chosen. hits: windows (fractions of the animation) in which it can hit, measured from the animations' limb speeds (tools/attack_timing.py). reach_m: from the creature's head end; arc_deg: 360 = all around. damage: low-rank hunter damage, scaled with the zone's monsters. track: how much the creature keeps turning to the hunter before the first hit (0..1).
